$comment: Tier-2 spec for the wardrobe wear ledger's DATA layer (P4.D255; v4 `wardrobe-wear.repository.ts` minus the chokepoint, `3ee3b1342`). ONE committed file drives BOTH sides: the oracle case `harness/oracle/cases/wardrobe-wear-stats-tier2.ts` builds the base DB per run at the pin (the table through v4's REAL `addWardrobeWearStatsTableMigration.run()` — never the repository), writes it to `QT_FIXTURE_OUT_DIR/base.db`, then runs `ops` through v4's REAL `WardrobeWearRepository`; the Rust test runs the same ops on a copy through `db::wardrobe_wear_stats`.

Each op's result (minted `id` / `createdAt` / `updatedAt` stripped from rows), its thrown message, and its log lines (level + message + the call's context, in v4's key order) are compared; then the table dump (rowid order, minus the three minted/clocked columns). The `absent` phase (after `dropTable`) compares results and lines only.

Shapes from v4's own spec (`__tests__/unit/lib/database/repositories/wardrobe-wear.repository.test.ts:90-235`): a later wear moves last forward; an EARLIER wear landing late never rewinds; a bad row rejects the whole batch (here a planted trigger refuses item `bad` — the Rust type cannot carry v4's `itemId: null`; recorded); one row per wearer; two NULL-wearer increments are one row; the fold sums / min / max-and-chat, and rolls back whole when its final DELETE fails (a planted BEFORE DELETE trigger on wearer `Z`); summaries total across wearers and an unknown id is never-worn; history most recent first incl. a lastWornAt TIE (stable); deleteByItemIds drops only those; upsertRows REPLACE semantics; findRowsForItems / findRowsForWearer; findAll; then the absent table.

ops.label: plant bad-row refusal
ops.sql: CREATE TRIGGER qt_bad_row BEFORE INSERT ON wardrobe_wear_stats WHEN NEW.itemId = 'bad' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'planted bad row'); END

ops.label: a batch with one bad row
one row per wearer + one unattributed row
a second item, two wearers, equal lastWornAt
plant fold delete failure
ops.sql: CREATE TRIGGER qt_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON wardrobe_wear_stats WHEN OLD.wearerCharacterId = 'Z' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'planted delete failure'); END
